description: List everyone who reviews for one of the organization's conferences, with the tracks each covers, their free-text expertise, and how many reviews they are already carrying. Use it before assign_reviewer — that tool needs a reviewer's user id, and this is where to get it — and to answer 'who still has capacity', 'who knows about this topic', or 'who have we invited'. A reviewer with status 'invited' has a pending invitation and no account yet, so they cannot be assigned work until they sign up. Requires an OAuth connection and the admin or committee role on the event.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: list_reviewers
title: List an event's reviewers
